Chaos Sanctuary preparation in a full game: isolate and destroy the Seal Bosses to spawn Diablo fast (Gameplay section refers to 'the Chaos Prep Build Variant'; no tab exists, loadout from planner profile #4; Act 5 Barbarian mercenary with Lawbringer).

Even in a full game, this build can spawn Diablo incredibly fast by focusing on popping Seals and assassinating the Seal Boss Super Uniques. See the "Chaos Prep" Build Variant to learn more about this strategy.
Optional: Cast Battle Cry near Act Bosses before slaying them with Berserk. This is especially helpful for reducing Diablo's Life on the "Chaos Prep" Build Variant.

dependencies.label: Actual linked Shael Rune

quotes: Stormshield socketed with Shael Rune

Specialises in defeating the Uber Bosses and mini-Ubers with Static Field and Charged Bolt, prioritising -Enemy Lightning Res, + Skills, Damage Reduction, Resistances and Life, at the 105% FCR breakpoint.

Swapping in Thundergod's Vigor and stacking Lightning Resistance allows this build to tank Uber Mephisto. Pre-buff Fade with Treachery prior to engaging the Ubers for massive boosts to Resistances and Damage Reduction. Using a Lower Resist Charge Wand on Weapon-Swap and Infinity on an Act 2 Mercenary enables you to maximize your damage output against all Uber Bosses except Uber Mephisto.
Crack of the Heavens breaks Uber Mephisto's Lightning Immunity, allowing you to deal more damage to him. Use Lightning Resist Charms to counteract its negative effect.

The Ubers Lightning Sorceress uses an Act 5 Frenzy Mercenary with 2x Plagues for their Lower Resist proc. This high Level Lower Resist breaks Uber Mephisto's Lightning Immunity. Vampire Gaze and Treachery make him tanky while avoiding high Defense.
Note: It is better to use the Standard Act 2 Might Mercenary with Infinity against every Uber Boss besides Uber Mephisto.

dependencies.label: Actual linked Um Rune

quotes: Stormshield socketed with Um Rune

One of the most common ways to kill the Uber Bosses as a Sorceress: as much Damage Reduction as possible while over-stacking Resistance for Mephisto's level 20 Conviction and a large Life pool, at 86% FHR and 105% FCR.
Note: You can use the Mercenary's Fade from Treachery Archon Plate to help with both Resistance and Damage Reduction.

Use Lower Resist at all times against bosses from Wand of Lower Resistance. Use Static Field to get bosses down to half of their Life. Trap bosses with Bone Prison from Marrowwalk. Spam Meteor to prevent the bosses from healing with burning Damage Over Time (DOT).

This setup for your Mercenary is a little different but aims to use x% Chance of Crushing Blow from Guillaume's Face, Fade from Treachery Archon Plate, and Conviction from Infinity Giant Thresher. Might Aura works great for extra Physical Damage.
